body:
## Summary
- Bump `.agent` from `acpx` 0.6.1 to 0.10.0.
- Keep Sepo's Claude default pinned to `claude-opus-4-8`.
- Remove the earlier adapter workaround; local testing shows newer acpx can set the pinned Claude model directly.

## Why
The failed PR #66 `/fix-pr` run used old acpx/Claude ACP behavior that rejected `claude-opus-4-8` because the adapter only advertised `default`, `opus`, and `haiku`.

I tested locally:
- `acpx` 0.6.1 failed around Claude model setting.
- `acpx` 0.10.0 successfully ran `claude set model claude-opus-4-8` and recorded `session_options.model = claude-opus-4-8`.

So the least invasive fix is to update acpx rather than adding Sepo-specific model env glue.

## Verification
- Local probe: `.agent/node_modules/.bin/acpx --format json claude set model claude-opus-4-8 -s <session>` succeeds with acpx 0.10.0.
- `npm --prefix .agent test`
- `git diff --check`
title: Fix Claude ACP model selection
